items: New brushes, clamp ammeter, and digital voltmeter.

sections.text: Inspect brush holders and slip rings.

Check brushes must move freely in the holders and must sit 
 to the rings by their full surface.

Check brush pressure in permanently given by the 
 holding-down system of the holders.
Check connection of cables of brushes must be tightened.

The 
 brush is replaced by new one if its height falls to 25 mm.

Measure the 
 current in each brush and record it in table (1) "if the current in any 
 brush less than 10A (according the recommendation from specialist), replace 
 it"

Measure the 
 leakage AC voltage between bearings of generator as fig (1) "approximately
 ≥ 2 فولت تيار متردد"
